reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness preset centered on delegation, root-session execution gating, child-agent coordination, and task-boundary rules, so its primary purpose is agent orchestration.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体编排预设，负责规划、委派和汇总任务，并对根会话的工具执行进行限制。
summaries.en: An agent-orchestration preset for DeepSeek Harness that plans, delegates, and synthesizes tasks while gating tool execution in the root session.

capabilities: Plans, delegates, and synthesizes work across agent sessions
Gates root-session execution and denies direct write, edit, PowerShell, and Bash calls
Provides bounded implementation access through child agents
Loads portable task-boundary, evidence, and safety operating rules
